recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, black-and-white urban portrait centered on a figure making a symbolic hand gesture, framed by heavy distressed textures and layered with weathered typography and faint background script.
coreVisualRelationships: Central figure anchored by a symmetrical hand gesture forming a triangle
Heavy, blocky display text layered over the subject's head
Faded, elegant script in the background contrasting with the gritty foreground
Rough, eroded borders framing the entire composition
coreInvariants: Symmetrical composition centered on the subject's torso and hands

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium close-up, centered, occupying the middle 60% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The hands joined in a triangular shape at the center-bottom of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large display text at the top, moves down to the subject's face, and rests on the central hand gesture.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dense and textured; very little 'empty' space, filled with script and grit.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black for shadows and framing.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure white for highlights and primary text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Mid-tone greys for background script and texture depth.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; extreme value contrast between highlights and shadows.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serifs and condensed sans-serifs
letterConstructionRules: Extreme distressing and erosion applied to all glyphs
Thick, blocky proportions for primary display text
Use of decorative flourishes (swashes) to frame secondary text
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters appear to be stenciled or stamped with uneven ink coverage
Edges are jagged and 'bitten' by texture
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy eroded slab-serif for impact paired with clean condensed sans-serif for legibility.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, industrial, and weathered look of the main title.
Provides the necessary weight and condensed structure for secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white portrait of a man in a dark hoodie and bandana, making a triangle gesture with his hands. The background should feature faint, elegant cursive script and heavy, gritty charcoal-like textures and borders.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply large, heavily distressed slab-serif text across the top. Add secondary condensed sans-serif text at the very top and bottom, framed by thin calligraphic swashes. Ensure all text looks weathered and integrated into the grit.

verificationChecks: Is the hand gesture centered and triangular?
Is the main text heavily eroded and textured?
Are there calligraphic flourishes framing the secondary text?

mustRedesign: Parental advisory label (use generic warning box instead)

avoid: Thin, delicate fonts for main titles

postGenerationChecks: Ensure no color bleeds into the monochrome palette.
Check that the text erosion doesn't make it unreadable.
Verify the 'dirty' texture covers the borders effectively.
Confirm the background script remains a subtle secondary layer.
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Portrait + Distressed Slab Typography + Symmetrical Hand Gesture + Gritty Monochrome Texture + Background Script Overlay.
